title: Bremen Upholstered Bed Mink Leatherette 180×200
description: Modern design double bed with an original headboard made of mink-coloured leatherette and a dark walnut-coloured wooden structure. A key piece for your bedroom with which you will bring an elegant and cosy style.It includes a comfortable bed base made of wood and upholstered in brown non-slip fabric. The leatherette upholstery of this bed will become the protagonist of your bedroom, bringing warmth and style to your sleeping area.

title: Dortmund Upholstered Bed Fabric Blue-Grey 180×200
description: The Dortmund's headboard and frame are upholstered in a light bluish-grey fabric — a cool, versatile tone that sits comfortably alongside both warm wood and crisp white bedding. Darkened, polished stainless steel legs give it a slightly industrial edge without tipping into cold or clinical. The pine multi-bed base underneath is built for daily use, and at 180×200 cm it suits most double-bedroom layouts without overwhelming the room.

title: Hamburg Upholstered Bed Leatherette Brown 180×200
description: Modern design double bed with an original headboard made of off-white fabric and brown leatherette structure, and black stainless steel legs. A key piece for your bedroom with which you will add an elegant and cosy style.It includes a comfortable multi-bed base made of pine wood. Its Capitonné upholstery gives it that distinctive and exclusive look you are looking for in your bedroom.

title: Berlin Upholstered Bed Fabric Light Grey 180×200
description: Light grey fabric covers the Berlin's headboard and frame in full — a neutral that reads calm rather than plain, and pairs equally well with muted or bolder accent colours in the rest of the room. The darkened, polished stainless steel legs add just enough contrast to keep the silhouette from disappearing into the wall. Underneath, a pine multi-bed base carries the mattress at a standard 180×200 cm — no assembly surprises, no unusual proportions to plan around.

title: Munich Upholstered Bed Fabric Light Grey 180×200
description: The Munich takes the same light grey fabric approach as its siblings in the range, but finishes the legs in black epoxy-painted stainless steel rather than polished metal — a matte, low-glare look that suits rooms where you'd rather the bed frame didn't catch the light. A pine multi-bed base supports the mattress, sized for 180×200 cm.

title: Saarland Viscoelastic Memory Foam Pillow – Lavender Scented | 75×35×15 cm
description: The Saarland pillow combines a perforated visco-elastic core with a lavender-scented cover for supportive, breathable comfort. Designed to contour to the head and neck while staying cool through the night, it's a considered choice for restful, aromatic sleep.

title: Nuremberg Upholstered Bed Leatherette Mink 180×200
description: Mink-coloured leatherette covers the Nuremberg's headboard and frame, with wooden legs finished in a matching walnut tone rather than the steel legs used elsewhere in the range — the whole piece stays in one warm colour family instead of contrasting fabric against metal. Pine multi-slat base, built for a 180×200 cm mattress.

title: Cologne Upholstered Bed Fabric Warm Grey 180×200
description: The Cologne's legs are wenge-coloured wood rather than the steel finishes used on several other beds in the collection — a deep, near-black tone that grounds the grey fabric headboard and frame in something warmer and more traditional. It's a fit for bedrooms already built around wood furniture rather than metal accents. The multi-bed base is pine, sized for a 180×200 cm mattress.

title: Düsseldorf Upholstered Bed Leatherette Cream 180×200
description: Cream leatherette wraps the Düsseldorf's headboard and frame, giving it a lighter, more reflective surface than the fabric beds in the range — easier to wipe clean, too, which matters if the bedroom doubles as a guest room. Black stainless steel legs keep the overall look from tipping too pale. Pine multi-bed base included, built for a 180×200 cm mattress.

title: Augsburg Upholstered Bed Fabric Light Grey 180×200
description: The Augsburg shares its light grey fabric and black epoxy-painted steel legs with the Munich — the same materials, built on the same 180×200 cm pine base. If you're comparing the two, the difference comes down to headboard stitching and proportions rather than materials, so pick based on which shape suits your room. Fabric upholstery throughout, easy to keep looking fresh with a light vacuum or brush.

title: Leipzig Upholstered Bed Mink Leatherette 160×200
description: The Leipzig is sized at 160×200 cm rather than the 180×200 cm standard used by most of this collection — worth checking against your room and existing bedding before ordering, since sheets and mattress toppers bought for the wider size won't fit. Mink-coloured leatherette covers the headboard and frame, with darkened polished stainless steel legs underneath. Pine multi-bed base included.

title: Bochum Upholstered Bed Leatherette Hazelnut Brown 180×200
description: Chocolate brown leatherette gives the Bochum a darker, richer starting point than the cream and mink leatherette options elsewhere in the range. The legs are wood veneered in natural walnut — the same leg treatment used on the Hannover — which softens the overall look compared with the steel-legged beds nearby. Pine multi-bed base, 180×200 cm mattress size.

title: Bonn Upholstered Bed Fabric Grey 180×200
description: The Bonn goes darker than the light-grey fabric beds in the collection — a dark grey fabric headboard and frame that reads more dramatic against pale walls, with black stainless steel legs to match rather than contrast. Pine multi-bed base, built for a 180×200 cm mattress.

title: Mannheim Upholstered Bed Leatherette Grey 160×200
description: The Mannheim mixes materials rather than using one throughout: a dark grey leatherette headboard, a walnut-veneered wood structure, and legs in black MDF — three different finishes working together instead of the single-material approach used on most beds in this collection. Pine slatted base. At 160×200 cm, it's sized for the narrower of the two mattress widths used across the range.

title: Hannover Upholstered Bed Fabric Grey 180×200
description: The Hannover pairs a grey fabric headboard and frame with walnut-veneered wooden legs — the same leg finish as the Bochum, though here it's set against fabric rather than leatherette. A middle-ground option for anyone who wants the warmth of wood legs without committing to a leatherette headboard. Pine multi-bed base, 180×200 cm.

title: Kiel Upholstered Bed Wood Walnut Grey 180×200
description: Modern design double bed with an original headboard and structure made of natural walnut veneer, and legs in black MDF wood, creating a warm and personal space. Thanks to its cushions sewn in grey fabric, it offers extra comfort. Includes a comfortable slatted base made of pine wood. Bed compatible with a 180 x 200 cm mattress.The fabric upholstery brings warmth and style to the sleeping area, and its elegant, modern design suits any bedroom. Made with high-quality materials and an internal structure of natural pine wood, its integrated shelves double as practical bedside tables.

title: Karlsruhe Upholstered Bed Leatherette Dark Green 180×200
description: Dark green is the least common headboard colour in this collection — most of the range sticks to greys, browns and creams, so the Karlsruhe stands out if you want a bed frame with more colour presence. The structure is wood veneered in natural walnut, giving it a warmer base than the steel-legged beds nearby. Pine multi-bed base, sized for a 180×200 cm mattress.

title: Wiesbaden Upholstered Bed Leatherette Brown 180×200
description: Brown leatherette covers the Wiesbaden's headboard and frame — a mid-tone that sits between the paler cream leatherette and the darker chocolate brown options elsewhere in the range. Black epoxy-painted steel legs keep the base low-key rather than drawing attention. Pine multi-bed base, 180×200 cm.

title: Münster Upholstered Bed Fabric Grey 160×200
description: The Münster shares its grey fabric, walnut-veneer structure and pine base with the Frankfurt — but the headboard itself is simpler: a plain button-tufted panel with no straps or bolsters, sitting at 74 cm tall. It's the quieter of the two if you'd rather the headboard not draw the eye. One of only four beds in the collection built around the narrower 160×200 cm mattress size rather than the more common 180×200 cm — check this against your current mattress and bedding before ordering.

title: Frankfurt Upholstered Bed Fabric Warm Grey 160×200
description: Like the Münster, the Frankfurt pairs grey fabric with a walnut-veneered wood structure on a pine base — but the headboard is the more decorative of the two: the same button-tufted panel, with two bolster cushions held on by leather straps for a more layered, styled look. It stands taller overall (110 cm vs. the Münster's 98 cm) to accommodate them. 160×200 cm mattress size, one of four in the collection built around this narrower width — worth confirming against your current bedding before ordering.

title: Stuttgart Upholstered Bed Leatherette Mink Grey 180×200
description: The Stuttgart's headboard is built in two layers: a tall mink-coloured leatherette back panel, with two square cushions sewn in grey fabric sitting in front of it — more sculptural than the single-fabric headboards elsewhere in the range. Legs are dark chrome. Pine multi-bed base, 180×200 cm, 100 kg overall.

title: Essen Wood Bed Walnut 160×200
description: Modern design double bed with an original headboard and structure made of wood veneered in natural walnut, with which you will create a warm and personal space, without leaving aside the greatest comfort. It includes a comfortable multi-sleeper bed base made of pine wood.Thanks to its simple, linear design, you can create a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere for your rest. All our beds are made with the highest quality materials, and with an internal structure of natural pine wood.

title: Bielefeld Upholstered Bed Leatherette Brown-Grey 180×200
description: Like the Stuttgart, the Bielefeld uses the same two-layer headboard — a tall leatherette back panel with two grey fabric cushions in front — but in a warmer rust-brown leatherette rather than mink, on plain stainless steel legs rather than dark chrome. Pine multi-bed base, 180×200 cm, 87 kg overall — noticeably lighter than the Stuttgart despite the shared design.

title: Dresden Upholstered Bed Fabric Dark Grey 180×200
description: The Dresden upholstered bed pairs a dark grey fabric cover with clean, modern lines and black stainless-steel legs — a quietly confident centerpiece for contemporary bedrooms.

title: Duisburg Upholstered Bed Fabric Light Grey 180×200
description: The Duisburg upholstered bed combines a soft light grey fabric cover with walnut-toned wood details and black stainless-steel legs, striking a calm balance between warmth and precision.

title: Wuppertal Upholstered Bed Velvet Brown Cream 180×200
description: The Wuppertal upholstered bed layers a velvety brown headboard over a cream leatherette base, creating a richly textured statement piece for elegant, modern bedrooms.

title: Braunschweig Upholstered Bed Fabric Beige Grey 160×200
description: The Braunschweig upholstered bed brings together a beige and grey fabric cover, walnut veneer details, and gold-toned stainless-steel accents for a refined, considered silhouette.

title: Freiburg Upholstered Bed Leatherette Sand 180×200
description: The Freiburg upholstered bed wraps a sand-toned leatherette headboard around warm walnut-coloured wood, offering a warm, understated presence in the bedroom.

title: Aachen Upholstered Bed Leatherette Cream 180×200
